name: Broodling Essence
summary: Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest asks you to bring Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900. Both are needed for her work in the Burning Steppes.

sections.title: Tinkee's Request
sections.body: At Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes, Tinkee Steamboil is waiting for you. She needs eight Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 brought to her.

faq.answer: Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes asks you to bring it.

faq.q: How many Broodling Essence does Tinkee need?
faq.answer: Tinkee asks for eight Broodling Essence.
She also asks you to bring the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900.
Tinkee Steamboil is at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
